content_descriptors.notes:
Adult Content Disclosure
The DLC "A Midsummer Night's Dream in Taipei: AI Interaction Chapter" is an expansion that adds an AI text-based interaction feature, allowing players to engage in deeper emotional conversations with the characters. The content focuses on romantic atmosphere and emotional storytelling, and does not contain any explicit sexual depictions or visual representations.

Content Advisory
This Game may include the following themes. Players are advised to evaluate their comfort level before playing:

Depictions of alcohol consumption (characters drink in certain social settings)

Emotional breakdowns, self-doubt, and psychological stress

Exploration of emotional vulnerability, loneliness, and similar themes

Not Included in the Game
This game does not contain the following sensitive or extreme content:

Depictions of sexual acts or sexual violence

Non-consensual sexual content

Substance abuse (drugs)

Self-harm, suicide, or graphic violence

Recommended Age Rating
This title is rated 12+ (Teen) and is suitable for players aged 12 and above.

While there is no explicit adult content, some emotional themes may affect players with lower psychological tolerance. Parental guidance or prior awareness is recommended.
